title: Towards Robust Mathematical Reasoning (IMO-ProofBench)
before: Gold-medal olympiad results were taken as evidence of general mathematical reasoning.
problem: Competition problems and their solutions circulate widely, so scores may reflect familiarity rather than reasoning.
breakthrough: A proof benchmark with novel problems, on which most models fell far below their headline results.
why: The clearest independent check on the year's most-cited reasoning claims, and a caution for reading any vendor benchmark.
inherits: Scepticism as a standard part of reading capability claims.
